turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Five students, one house, one bathroom. It's grim. How do we split the cleaning?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Make a rotating rota with five jobs, one per person, changing every week. Bathroom, kitchen, bins, hoover, and the shared living room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My new flat is on the tenth floor and the balcony is so windy. I need plants that cope.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Options first, Moshi, then your take.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was looking at ornamental grasses, they sway around and apparently don't snap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lavender is another idea, because it's tough and smells nice when you brush past.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or succulents in heavy pots, since they hold onto water and stay low.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Phew, done. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd mix the first two. Grasses for height and movement, lavender lower down for scent. Keep the succulents for the most sheltered corner, and use heavy pots for all of them so nothing takes off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone will just not do it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Probably. Agree a small penalty together, like the slacker buys the next round of toilet roll and bin bags.
